name: Whitemarsh Hall

dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox: construction started 1916, completed 1921, demolished 1980, 6 floors, 100,000 square feet; its text: 147 rooms, 'the largest American house ever to be demolished on purpose'. Wikipedia files it under both 'Georgian architecture in Pennsylvania' and 'Neoclassical architecture in Pennsylvania' and its infobox says 'Neoclassical Revival'; the node calls it Neo-Georgian.
